description: Defines the Camera3SharedOutputStream class for managing shared camera output streams, including setup, buffer management, and stream sharing functionalities within Android's camera framework.

classes.name: Camera3SharedOutputStream
classes.description: A class for managing shared output streams in Android's camera framework, supporting multiple surfaces, buffer sharing, and stream splitting.

methods.name: Camera3SharedOutputStream
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a shared output stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: ~Camera3SharedOutputStream
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the shared output stream.

methods.name: notifyBufferReleased
methods.description: Notify that a buffer has been released.

methods.name: isConsumerConfigurationDeferred
methods.description: Check if consumer configuration is deferred for a given surface ID.

methods.name: setConsumers
methods.description: Set the list of consumer surfaces.

methods.name: getSurfaceId
methods.description: Retrieve the surface ID for a given surface.

methods.name: getUniqueSurfaceIds
methods.description: Get unique surface IDs from current surface IDs.

methods.name: updateStream
methods.description: Update the stream with new output surfaces and info.

methods.name: getOfflineProcessingSupport
methods.description: Indicate whether offline processing is supported (returns false).

methods.name: connectStreamSplitterLocked
methods.description: Initialize the stream splitter for sharing.

methods.name: attachBufferToSplitterLocked
methods.description: Attach a buffer to the stream splitter.

methods.name: getBufferLocked
methods.description: Retrieve a buffer for a given set of surface IDs.

methods.name: queueBufferToConsumer
methods.description: Queue a buffer to a consumer surface.

methods.name: disconnectLocked
methods.description: Disconnect and clean up the stream.

methods.name: getEndpointUsage
methods.description: Get usage flags for the stream endpoint.
